title: Bram and the Harbor
author: Ulyana Voss
blurb: Ansel Eastwick, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
